definitions.explanation: Physical harm or damage to the body from an accident or attack.

examples.japanese: けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
けが⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しない⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to get injured.

examples.japanese: けが⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}かった→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です。
examples.english: The injury was minor, so I'm fine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、けが⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧して⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I fell off my bicycle and got injured.

notes:
けが refers to physical harm or damage to the body from accidents or external causes.

KANJI:
Can be written as {怪我|けが}, but hiragana is common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- けがをする: to get injured
- けがを{治|なお}す: to heal an injury
- けがが{治|なお}る: injury heals

COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}けが: serious injury
- {軽|かる}いけが: minor injury
- けが{人|にん}: injured person

NOTE:
けが refers to injuries from external causes. For illness, use {病気|びょうき} instead.
